colorMask: R<135, G-R>30, B-R>30, G>65; unmodified original JPEG pixels
boundaryInterpretation: Inside edge of original cartographic stroke; source-cell boundaries are half-integer pixel coordinates adjacent to actual teal pixels. They are not claimed to be source-pixel centers or OSM coordinates.

registration.method: Robust affine matching of actual small source-color dash component centroids to the contemporary municipal perimeter. This is a registration diagnostic, not independent boundary accuracy.

otherNumberedUnitsNotExported: Thin units with numeric disks crossing their boundary require explicit occlusion interpretation; compound groups9/15/16 and outerareas17..20 are not individual fine quarters.
